g.text: The egress decision: grant at start, checked answer per connection
the class is a ceiling the profile cannot raise
a profile destination is outside the class?
with the class's wildcard and port matching
announce "egress grant is empty: this jail has no route out"
which the code renders as --grant "" when the grant is empty
check every answer against the blocked ranges
in the class, not in the profile grant
The DNS half makes the same decision in one step: a granted name answers
127.0.0.1, and any other name is nxdomain with reason not-in-profile (the
class has it, this jail was not granted it) or not-in-class.
